description: Your free book and audiobook laboratory. Turn the PDFs you own into chapter-marked M4B audiobooks and read-along books, on your own machine. Local TTS, AI cleanup, translations and rewrites, RAG chat with cited sources across your library. Apple Silicon Mac, Linux, or one Docker container on a headless server.
